reserveReview.rationale: STT Assets Limited's September 30, 2026 Transparency and Reserves Report (dated October 15, 2026) affirms 1,019.32330 kg of LBMA Good Delivery 99.99% fine silver vaulted at Brink's Hong Kong Limited under consignment reference AG42840 (Pallet #11B, 12) backing 32,771.957 circulating STT tokens (1,019.32330 kg / 0.0311034768 kg per troy ounce = 32,771.957 troy oz). The report appends a Brink's Hong Kong Ltd. confirmation letter dated July 15, 2026 and the May 15, 2026 Holding Certificate for 1,019.3233 kg. Pinned Ethereum totalSupply at finalized block 26505987 (2026-11-27T10:37:11Z) is exactly 32,771.957000 STT. No independent CPA or third-party accounting-firm attestation has been published, and no October 2026 report was live as of November 27, 2026.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: STT Assets Limited Transparency and Reserves Report STT-TR-2026-SEP as of September 30, 2026, corroborated by Brink's Hong Kong confirmation letters
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete backing asset is identified as 1,019.32330 kg of physical silver at Brink's Hong Kong Limited, matching Ethereum supply 1:1. However, the September 2026 report is a management affirmation attaching July 15 and May 15 Brink's vault confirmations rather than an independent accounting-firm audit, and individual bar serial lists and trust deeds are not published.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Brink's Hong Kong Limited confirms holding 1,019.3233 kg of silver under reference AG42840 (Pallet #11B, 12) for STT Assets Limited (note the standalone May 15 certificate initially named Best Power Development Limited in the body while the September report's re-issued May 15 certificate and July 15 letter name STT Assets Limited). Whitepaper v9.2 describes an Orphan Trust under a Hong Kong TCSP-licensed trustee with beneficial ownership for STT holders, but neither the trustee's identity, the trust deed, an insolvency opinion, nor an explicit rehypothecation prohibition is publicly published. Legacy landing-page copy still references Brink's London despite the Brink's Hong Kong vault certificates.
